messages:
maria: Heads-up — I want to run the repro harness on last week's prod traces to validate kernel selection + KV behavior before we ship the batching heuristic change.

jon: SG, what are success criteria? apples-to-apples vs current prod? :thinking:

maria: Yes: same model checkpoint, same tokenization, same request ordering where possible. We need deterministic seeding for the trace replayer and to preserve prefix ordering.

lee: Key anonymization note: strip user ids, replace text payloads with sampled prompts but keep length/entropy profiles. For now we use the anonymizer v2 tool: `anonymizer --profile=length,entropy --map=uuid`.

sara: Sampling plan proposal: 8% uniform per-user slice + 1% heavy-user oversample. Keep contiguous sessions to preserve KV warmup patterns.

jon: Determinism checklist: fixed RNG seed, freeze CUDA/CUDNN conv heuristics, disable non-deterministic kernels, set `TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS=1` equivalent for our runtime. Also pin kernel choice to "auto" vs "legacy" to test both.

maria: Parity checks: run token-level hash diff after each segment. If diff > 0.1% mark as "semantic drift" and attach traces.

perf-bot: [perf-bot] Reminder: attach kernel and NVTX timelines. Command:
```
run_repro --seed=42 --anon=anonymizer_v2 --sample=8,1 --trace-embed --profiling=nvtx,ktrace
```

lee: KV cache behavior: capture hit-rate per step and per-session. Also record first-token latency vs mid-sequence. We expect ~10-15% warmup perf win on long sessions.

sara: For apples-to-apples, ensure same batching window and max_batch_size. We'll test 0ms, 10ms, 50ms windows and report throughput/latency P50/P95.

jon: If we see regressions, label run 'regress-<gitsha>' and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/repro/ + create issue with reproducer link.

maria: Awesome — I'll run a small-scale check today (seed 42) and post results. If anyone has preflight scripts, drop them here. :rocket:

lee: Dropping my anonymizer config:
```
{ "map": "uuid", "preserve_lengths": true, "keep_entropy_buckets": true }
```

sara: also remember to scrub any customer PII from metadata fields — reviewers will block otherwise.

maria: Thanks. tagging @eng-runtime on follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
